title: Shem MiShmuel

description: Popular 20th-century, nine-volume collection of sermons delivered by Rabbi Shmuel Bornsztain. Complete Chasidut text imported from Sefaria; the exact edition and licence are shown with each version.
historicalContext: Hasidic literature gathers sermons, letters and teachings from the movement's dynasties and schools. Individual works are attributed to specific rebbes and schools rather than to Chasidut as a whole.
